item.description: Local entrepreneur Austin McChord expects to spend $410 million on planning and preparation for the polluted former power plant site.

item.title: Supreme Court strikes down Trump-era tariffs, impacting outlook for some CT companies
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court on Friday invalidated a broad set of tariffs imposed during President Donald J. Trump’s second term, creating further uncertainty for Connecticut businesses.

item.title: 🔒 CT bill seeks to license long-term, acute care hospitals
item.description: A bill in the state legislature seeks to create a licensing process for long-term acute care hospitals in Connecticut.

item.title: Century-old CT inn sells for $3.5M after after redevelopment approval
item.description: A century-old inn in Connecticut’s northwestern corner has sold for $3.5 million following local approval of a high-profile redevelopment plan that drew significant local attention and opposition

item.title: 🔒 FuelCell Energy proxy reveals more executive departures, employee cost-cutting bonus
item.description: Danbury-based FuelCell Energy Inc. quietly parted ways with four senior executives over the last year and rewarded workers with bonuses for identifying cost savings, according to the company’s annual proxy statement filed this week.

item.title: Pitney Bowes quietly relocates Connecticut headquarters
